description: A mutual professional connection request. The requester creates this record; the subject accepts by creating their own record with the requester as subject. Both records must exist for the connection to be active. Either party can delete their record to sever the connection.

main.description: Record representing a professional connection request or acceptance. Lives in the author's PDS.

subject.description: DID of the other party in the connection.

origins.description: How the connection originated. Each side can independently set their own origins.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this connection record was created.

origin.description: Describes how a connection originated — a shared project, event, or common interest.

uri.description: Optional AT URI referencing the origin record (e.g. a project or event record).
